title: Phillips–Toms radius-of-comparison formula for minimal integer actions
exact_target: For every minimal homeomorphism h of an infinite compact metrizable space X, is $rc(C(X)\rtimes _hZ)=mdim(X,h)/2$, allowing the value infinity? In particular is zero mean dimension equivalent to the small boundary property, Z-stability and finite nuclear dimension of the crossed product?
